outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating camera exposure time vs illumination overhead with percentage labels; it is not a data plot requiring individual points.
Panel B is a line plot of photobleaching decay curves (mean±s.e.m. shaded). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel C is a scatter/line plot (ΔROS vs exposure time, mean±s.e.m. per condition with fitted curve). Scatter plots are exempt from the requirement.
Panel D shows migration track line plots for individual cells; line plots are exempt, and each line already represents an individual cell's track, not an aggregated summary.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual cell data points (dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (MitoTracker, Paxillin, merge), not a quantitative plot.
Panel G is a time-course series of micrographs, not a plot.
Panel H is a time-course series of micrographs, not a plot.
Panel I is a line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel J is a line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
